# What Green Goods Can Honestly Claim

This ledger separates what people can use now from deployed protocol capability, work in progress, plans, and longer-term vision. Marketing and partnership language should reuse the safe wording below.

## available

### Communities can organize people and records around a shared Garden.

**Internal claim:** Green Goods gives a real community, its roles, and its records one accountable Garden.

**Audience:** community · steward · funder

**Evidence:** `packages/contracts/deployments/42161-latest.json` — Garden and Hats modules are deployed on Arbitrum. (verified 2026-08-15)

### Gardeners can document Work in the field and sync it when connectivity returns.

**Internal claim:** Gardeners can submit portable Work evidence, including through the offline queue.

**Audience:** gardener · steward · funder

**Evidence:** `packages/shared/src/modules/job-queue` — Offline-first submission queue is the runtime write boundary. (verified 2026-08-15)

### Stewards review Work and record an approval or rejection separately.

**Internal claim:** Stewards approve or reject submitted Work through a separate attestation.

**Audience:** steward · funder · evaluator

**Evidence:** `packages/contracts/src/resolvers/WorkApproval.sol` — Work Approval is Steward-only and separate from Work submission. (verified 2026-08-15)

### Assessments make the baseline, plan, and evidence standard explicit.

**Internal claim:** Stewards and Evaluators can define a baseline and strategy before Work begins.

**Audience:** steward · evaluator · funder

**Evidence:** `packages/contracts/src/resolvers/Assessment.sol` — Assessment authorizes both Evaluator and Steward roles. (verified 2026-08-15)

### Support can meet near-term needs or remain deposited so yield supports work over time.

**Internal claim:** Gardens can receive direct operational support and longer-term Vault deposits.

**Audience:** funder · steward

**Evidence:** `packages/contracts/deployments/42161-latest.json` — Vault and Cookie Jar modules are deployed. (verified 2026-08-15)

## deployed-not-available

### The coordination protocol is deployed, but it is not yet an available Green Goods product flow.

**Internal claim:** Green Goods has deployed onchain coordination for bounded offers, requests, cycles, contributors, and confirmation.

**Audience:** steward · community · partner

**Evidence:** `.plans/active/commitment-pooling/status.json` — Pooling is unpaused with 18 registered pools; indexer/shared/UI remain blocked. (verified 2026-08-15)

## in-build

### Green Goods is building the activation path that turns approved Work into portable Impact Certificates.

**Internal claim:** Approved Work can become portable Impact Certificates.

**Audience:** funder · steward · gardener

**Evidence:** `packages/contracts/deployments/42161-latest.json` — Hypercert contracts are deployed, while activation and indexing remain environment-dependent. (verified 2026-08-15)

## planned

### Community Needs is a planned layer, not a feature people can use today.

**Internal claim:** Communities will be able to name Needs, signal support, and connect commitments and funding evidence.

**Audience:** community · steward · funder

**Evidence:** `.plans/active/community-interface/status.json` — Community Needs remains planned with blocked implementation lanes. (verified 2026-08-15)
